name: spoofer
description: Chrome extension that presents websites with the geolocation and time zone of a City the user picks.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.package: rm -rf extension/dist spoofer-$npm_package_version.zip && npm run build && cd extension && zip -qr ../spoofer-$npm_package_version.zip . -x '*.DS_Store'
